successCriteria.description: ILeaveRequestService interface exposes all 9 methods: create(dto: CreateLeaveRequestDto), submit(id: string), approve(id: string, approverId: string), reject(id: string, approverId: string), cancel(id: string, cancelledBy: string), update(id: string, dto: UpdateLeaveRequestDto), getById(id: string), query(params: LeaveRequestQueryParams), getEmployeeRequests(employeeId: string)
create() validates employee is ACTIVE via IEmployeeService.getById, policy is active via ILeavePolicyService.getById, endDate >= startDate, and creates the request in DRAFT status

submit() transitions only from DRAFT; validates employee active, policy active, minimumNoticeDays (skipped when policy.leaveType === LeaveType.EMERGENCY), no overlapping requests via findOverlapping, sufficient balance via getRemainingDays using inclusive formula daysRequested = (endDate - startDate) + 1; transitions to SUBMITTED
approve() transitions only from SUBMITTED; deducts days via ILeaveBalanceService.deductDays using the same inclusive formula; sets approvedBy, approvedAt, status=APPROVED
reject() transitions only from SUBMITTED; performs no balance change; sets approvedBy, approvedAt, status=REJECTED

cancel() transitions from SUBMITTED or APPROVED; if from APPROVED, restores days via ILeaveBalanceService.restoreDays; if from SUBMITTED, no balance change; sets cancelledBy, cancelledAt, status=CANCELLED
Fiscal year is computed as startDate.getFullYear() (calendar year); cross-year requests are charged entirely to the startDate's fiscal year

Service throws ValidationError for business rule violations (invalid state transition, inactive employee/policy, insufficient balance, invalid date range), NotFoundError for missing entities, ConflictError for overlapping requests

LeaveRequestController has 8 handler methods (createLeaveRequest, submitLeaveRequest, approveLeaveRequest, rejectLeaveRequest, cancelLeaveRequest, updateLeaveRequest, getLeaveRequest, queryLeaveRequests), each using Zod schemas for request validation and mapping domain errors to HTTP status codes (400/404/409)

leave-request.routes.ts exports a default Fastify plugin registering all 8 routes (POST /leave-requests, POST /leave-requests/:id/submit, POST /leave-requests/:id/approve, POST /leave-requests/:id/reject, POST /leave-requests/:id/cancel, PUT /leave-requests/:id, GET /leave-requests/:id, GET /leave-requests)
src/modules/leave-request/index.ts barrel export re-exports LeaveRequestService, LeaveRequestController, and leaveRequestRoutes alongside the model and repository exports

constraints: Service constructor MUST inject ILeaveRequestRepository, IEmployeeService, ILeavePolicyService, ILeaveBalanceService — no direct instantiation of dependencies inside the service
All database access goes through repository interfaces (ILeaveRequestRepository, ILeaveBalanceRepository) — no inline SQL/ORM calls in service or controller
